gloss: secondhand articles; old furniture and utensils

definitions.explanation: Old furniture, utensils, and other household items that have been used and are sold or kept second-hand. Includes things of little value as well as collectable ones.

examples.japanese: {古道具|ふるどうぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
{古道具屋|ふるどうぐや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought an old clock at a secondhand shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{蔵|くら}→蔵：13991_kura⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}てきた→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧{古道具|ふるどうぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、{骨董市|こっとういち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ことにした。
examples.english: We decided to put the old articles that turned up in my grandfather's storehouse into an antiques fair.

notes:
⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧ (old) + ⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧ (tool, utensil). {古道具屋|ふるどうぐや} is a secondhand shop selling such goods, often with a nostalgic, cluttered image.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{骨董品|こっとうひん}→骨董品：06990_kottouhin⟧: antique; old and valued for its age or rarity
- ⟦{中古品|ちゅうこひん}→中古品：08302_chuukohin⟧: used item; any second-hand product, including cars and electronics
- ⟦{古物|こぶつ}→古物：24097_kobutsu⟧: secondhand goods (legal and trade term)
